newsitem.title: UK: Oct North Sea crude liftings fall three percent.
newsitem.headline: Oct North Sea crude liftings fall three percent.

text.p: Crude oil loadings from the North Sea's eight main export systems should fall by nearly three percent in October, schedules released recently show.
October liftings under the programmes would average 4.40 million barrels per day (bpd), 130,000 bpd fewer than in September.
Schedules for October liftings from Britain's Brent, Forties and Flotta and Norway's Ekofisk, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Statfjord and Troll detail 136.5 million barrels in 237 cargoes.
Loadings in September were expected to total 136 million barrels in 234 cargoes according to original programmes.
Traders said the longer month and major maintenance work at Norway's Gullfaks system were behind the fall in daily volumes.
